effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDT to the vault (safeTransferFrom(caller, vault, assets)), spending the signer's USDT allowance to the vault.
The receiver gets Re7USDT shares, computed from the vault's total assets after fees (rounded down). No minimum is enforced.
formats.shown: Intent 'Deposit', the USDT amount as 'Deposit asset', a constant 'Share ticker: Re7USDT', and the receiver as 'Send shares to'.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many Re7USDT shares the receiver gets; the vault rate sets it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` Descriptor shows only `assets`, the constant `vaultTicker` and `receiver`.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. ERC-4626 deposit has no minShares parameter.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name the USDT asset or the Re7USDT vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent. The 'Share ticker' field is a raw constant with no amount.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDT into Re7USDT vault" and add an interpolatedIntent such as "Deposit {assets} for shares to {receiver}".

effects: The signer sends USDT to the vault. The amount is computed from `shares` at the vault rate, rounded up, with no maximum bound.
The receiver gets exactly `shares` Re7USDT shares (18 decimals).
formats.shown: Intent 'Mint', a constant 'Deposit asset: USDT', the share amount as 'Minted shares' in Re7USDT, and the receiver as 'Mint shares to'.

findings.title: mint does not show how much USDT leaves the signer; the vault rate sets it, with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` ERC4626._deposit: `SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets);` The descriptor shows only the 'Deposit asset' ticker USDT as a raw constant, with no amount.
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter. A label such as 'USDT taken (set by vault rate)' would warn the signer.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' does not say that the signer pays USDT for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. The only sign of a payment is the field `"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit USDT to mint Re7USDT shares" and add an interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for USDT to {receiver}".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns Re7USDT shares from `owner`. The share count is computed from `assets`, rounded up, with no maximum bound.
When the signer is not `owner`, the call spends the signer's share allowance from `owner`.
The receiver gets exactly `assets` USDT from the vault.
formats.shown: Intent 'Withdraw', the USDT amount as 'Withdraw exactly', the receiver as 'To', and the owner as 'Owner'.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many Re7USDT shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. ERC-4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not name USDT or the Re7USDT vault.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw USDT from Re7USDT vault" and add an interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` Re7USDT from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, this spends the signer's share allowance.
The receiver gets USDT computed from the shares at the vault rate, rounded down. No minimum is enforced.
formats.shown: Intent 'Redeem', the share amount as 'Shares to redeem' in Re7USDT, the receiver as 'To', and the owner as 'Owner'.

findings.title: redeem does not show the USDT amount the receiver gets, and no minimum applies.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);`
findings.fix: None possible from calldata. ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter.

findings.title: redeem intent 'Redeem' and its fields never say that the signer receives USDT.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: `"intent": "Redeem"`. Its fields are `shares`, `receiver` and `owner`. Unlike mint and deposit, it has no USDT ticker field.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem Re7USDT shares for USDT" and add an interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for USDT to {receiver}".
